title: High-definition helicopter video of orbs rising from the ocean off Kuwait
place_text: About 20 miles off the coast of Kuwait

tellings.quote: a report of a very highquality video shot from a helicopter of an orb coming out of the ocean about 20 miles off the coast of Kuwait being joined by another orb

plain: A very clear video, filmed from a helicopter about 20 miles off the coast of Kuwait, is said to show a glowing ball rising out of the ocean and then being joined by a second one. The journalist Michael Shellenberger describes it on the show. He takes it from a report on a secret government program, said to be called Immaculate Constellation, that collected sightings like this, and if the report is right, the government holds high-quality footage of such objects that it has never released.
